summary: Summary of items and amounts provided by the caller, without performing transactions.
whenToUse: Showing an order breakdown before confirmation.
whenNotToUse: Calculating taxes or handling checkout: amounts are provided by the caller.

props.name: subtotalLabel / discountLabel / taxLabel / totalLabel
props.description: Localizable labels for the summary rows.

accessibility: Uses a description list to associate each amount with its label.
responsive: Long labels wrap without overlapping the amounts.
customization: Uses --dc-* tokens for surfaces, borders and typography.
commonMistakes: Passing inconsistent amounts: the component does not recalculate the total.
limits: Does not calculate taxes, discounts or payments.
